programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Papi Gudia

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Jigri Dost
programme.desc: Shobha prepares to marry an advocate named Anand as arranged by her father. However, she secretly follows him one day and is shocked to see him in the arms of another woman.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Mafia Raaj
programme.desc: An honest police officer has a mission to wipe out a mafia group. But in the process, he is forced to sacrifice not only his father but also his sister.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Khel Khilari Ka

programme.title: Pataakha
programme.desc: Badki and Chhutki are two sisters who constantly keep fighting with one another. However, when they get married, they understand each other's importance and build a stronger bond.

programme.title: Naya Kadam

programme.title: Krantiveer
programme.desc: After being disowned by his family, Pratap, a juvenile gambler, ends up in Mumbai where he gets adopted by Laxminath, a landlord. However, when Laxminath is murdered, Pratap vows to avenge him.

programme.title: Simon Daniel
programme.desc: An archaeologist embarks on a treasure hunt in an old estate, which his now missing friend had started. His mission to find his friend and the treasure does not come without the horrors of the place.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Kaali Topi Laal Roomaal
programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: Jagan

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: S14 E16 — We're All Friends: Pick Your OwnJustin and George meet a friend at a fruit and veg garden, while Mr Tumble sets up a shop.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S2 — King; Crazy GolfThe Teletubbies have televisions in their stomachs on which they watch real children. A large, pinwheel-shaped windmill begins a magical event during episodes.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: S1 E15 — GrassesRanger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how grasses play such an important role in the environment. They find out that grasses can be food for animals and some can be turned into ingredients to make food for people too. On the way, they discover how long grass can help shelter small animals and insects, and that cut grass can be useful too, before finding a lovely grassy place to relax and have fun.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: S2 E17 — Bubbles and ChocolateMaddie finds out how bubbles work when she blows into bubble mixture. She shows how the surface tension of water changes when she adds soap and how to stop bubbles from bursting with her hands, and using her slow-motion camera, she shows how bubbles make a sphere shape.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: S2 E8 — Farm MachinesGrace shows off three amazing machines that help with farming. Grace drives a massive compost turner, shows off a machine that makes hay bales and then picks some tasty carrots in a carrot harvester.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: S4 E4 — A Toy Tiger Comes to SchoolLucas and his classmates are learning to write the letter 't' for tiger. After watching how it's done by Mrs Collins, Lucas helps his friend Otto. The children discover the classroom is in a mess and a spot tiger paw print on the floor. Could it be a toy tiger causing havoc in the school? Lucas has an idea to track down the toy tiger - leaving out pictures and some food - but will it work?

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: S3 E3 — Cone SnailsOnly Peso can save the day when a cone snail invades the Octopod and picks off the crew one by one with its dangerous harpoons.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S1 — The Tale of the Wriggly WormsWhen Peter makes a rash promise to appease an angry Tommy Brock, he and his friends find themselves worming for their lives.

programme.title: Hey Duggee

programme.title: Piripenguins

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: S2 E20 — Carrot Powers UpCarrot wants to become superstrong, so she restores Evil Pea's robot suit for herself.

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Mission Game OverThe ducklings confiscate Weasy's phone after he becomes obsessed with playing on it.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Got Your GoatHow hard can it be to pick one plant at the top of a mountain with Mojo's Chopper Top? Pretty hard when there's a hungry goat who wants that plant even more than they do.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E15 — ExplorersWhile waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Jack's dad, however, has got lost en route to collect him.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E4 — SquashWhen Dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo pretend that they are in control of their every move. Bingo proves that big siblings don't always beat little siblings.

programme.title: Balamory

They look just like Waffle, and during a game of hide-and-sing the dogs all hide next door, causing confusion and chaos for poor Mrs Hobbs!

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos.

programme.title: Planes
programme.desc: A crop duster longs to be a racing plane, but is hamstrung by a fear of heights. With the aid of a veteran flyer, he learns to conquer his phobia and compete against some of the world's greatest flyers in a round-the-world race. Animated adventure spin-off from Pixar's Cars, with the voices of Dane Cook, Teri Hatcher and Stacy Keach.

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: A deformed bell-ringer living reclusively in a cathedral in the heart of medieval Paris is tempted out of seclusion when a gypsy festival arrives and captures his imagination. Here in the outside world, he learns the cruel government minister who raised him is hatching a plan to wipe out the gypsies, so he resolves to protect his new friends. Disney animation, with the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: The four Pevensie children are summoned back to the magical land of Narnia to find centuries have passed in their absence. War is now brewing, and the young heroes must help Prince Caspian, the rightful king of Narnia, to overthrow his cruel uncle and reclaim the throne. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Ben Barnes, William Moseley, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell and Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: National Treasure: Book of Secrets
programme.desc: Intrepid archaeologist Ben Gates sets out to clear the family name when evidence emerges that an ancestor was involved in the assassination of Abraham Lincoln. His mission leads him on another globe-trotting treasure hunt that uncovers a secret conspiracy. Adventure sequel, starring Nicolas Cage, Helen Mirren, Ed Harris, Harvey Keitel and Jon Voight.

programme.title: Inspector Gadget
programme.desc: A clumsy security guard is critically injured during a run-in with a thief, so his cybernetics-expert employer transforms him into the ultimate crime-fighting machine - a bionic officer with an array of gadgets and weaponry cunningly concealed inside his body. Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

programme.title: Gifted
programme.desc: Single man Frank Adler attempts to raise his child prodigy niece, Mary. However, his plans for a normal school life for the youngster are foiled when the youngster's mathematical abilities come to the attention of Frank's formidable mother, Evelyn. Drama, starring Chris Evans, Lindsay Duncan and Mckenna Grace.

programme.title: The Wild
programme.desc: The son of a lion kept in a zoo in Central Park is crated up and shipped to Africa. His worried father musters a band of fellow creatures and escapes from captivity in a quest to rescue the youngster. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Kiefer Sutherland, James Belushi, Eddie Izzard, Janeane Garofalo and William Shatner.

programme.title: Starship Troopers
programme.desc: Courageous military recruits hurl themselves into a desperate war against alien insects set on destroying mankind. They blast off for the creatures' home planet in a last-ditch attempt to save the human race from annihilation - little realising the carnage that awaits them. Sci-fi adventure from director Paul Verhoeven, starring Casper Van Dien, Denise Richards and Dina Meyer.

programme.title: Alien: Covenant
programme.desc: A crew of colonists sent to populate an alien planet have their mission diverted by a mysterious signal. After landing on a nearby world, they discover what became of the ill-fated Prometheus mission. Ridley Scott's sci-fi thriller, starring Katherine Waterston, Michael Fassbender and Danny McBride.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: Percy Jackson & the Lightning Thief
programme.desc: A teenager is shocked to discover he is the son of Greek god Poseidon and has been accused of stealing Zeus's lightning bolt. The youngster is given 14 days to find the culprit and return the missing item before the furious deity instigates an apocalyptic war. Fantasy adventure, starring Logan Lerman, Pierce Brosnan, Brandon T Jackson, Alexandra Daddario, Jake Abel, Sean Bean and Steve Coogan.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos.

programme.title: Lilo & Stitch
programme.desc: A lonely little girl befriends a runaway alien that helps mend her fractured family. Live action fantasy adventure, starring Maia Kealoha and Sydney Agudong.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: The four Pevensie children are summoned back to the magical land of Narnia to find centuries have passed in their absence. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Ben Barnes, William Moseley, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell and Peter Dinklage.

programme.desc: Six years after the events of Wreck-It Ralph, the destructive video game character and his hyperactive friend Vanellope discover a wi-fi router in Litwak's Family Fun Centre and Arcade. Before long, they embark on a new quest involving Disney princesses, and a few familar faces. Animated adventure, with the voices of John C Reilly, Sarah Silverman and Gal Gadot.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader
programme.desc: Lucy and Edmund Pevensie return to the magical world accompanied by their selfish cousin. They join their old friend King Caspian as he sets sail across the sea in search of seven of his father's allies who had been banished years before, but along the way they discover an evil force is growing in strength. Fantasy adventure, with Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Will Poulter and Ben Barnes.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: A doting dad is taken aback when his daughter announces she is getting married, and is thrown into a whirlwind of increasingly complicated wedding plans, a struggle to live up to the expectations of his wealthy future in-laws and the sad realisation that his little girl has grown up. Remake of the 1950s comedy, with Steve Martin, Diane Keaton, Kimberly Williams and Martin Short.

programme.title: Tron: Legacy
programme.desc: Ground-breaking computer genius Kevin Flynn disappears without trace. Years later, his son Sam goes looking for him, and is transported into a computer-generated world where he is forced to compete in deadly gladiatorial combat by an evil duplicate of his father plotting to wage war on the real world. Sci-fi adventure, with Jeff Bridges and Garrett Hedlund.

programme.title: Victor Frankenstein
programme.desc: A sideshow performer is taken in by a scientist, who seeks his help in performing experiments to create life, and hopefully uncover the secrets of immortality. The plan goes dangerously out of control, and it falls to the devoted assistant to save his master from his dark obsessions and his monstrous creation. Gothic horror, starring James McAvoy and Daniel Radcliffe.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A child who grows up in slavery becomes a formidable warrior and a cunning thief. Taken prisoner by a victorious king, he is sent out to destroy the leader of the barbaric cult that destroyed his village and slaughtered his family. Fantasy adventure, based on the stories by author Robert E Howard, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Max von Sydow, James Earl Jones and Sandahl Bergman.

programme.title: (500) Days of Summer
programme.desc: A greetings card employee looks back on his relationship with the woman he loves, after she has seemingly left him for good. As he recalls the key events of the 500 days he knew her, the ups and downs of their romance are presented in random order. Romantic comedy, starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Zooey Deschanel.

programme.title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
programme.desc: An eccentric marine expert sets out in search of a legendary shark that ate his old friend and shipmate. Unfortunately the voyage is riddled with problems, including a man claiming to be his long-lost son, a pursuing pirate crew and a rival oceanographer. Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Bill Murray, Owen Wilson, Cate Blanchett, Willem Dafoe and Jeff Goldblum.

Here in the outside world, he learns the cruel government minister who raised him is hatching a plan to wipe out the gypsies, so he resolves to protect his new friends. Disney animation, with the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline.

Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson.

programme.desc: S1 E3Josie Gibson and the team are in Brighton helping Dan, whose home has been taken over by his fiancee's stash of vintage treasures. As a result, one room is now full of old stock and new dad Dan wants it gone to create a bedroom for their daughter. Tensions run high when all is revealed - is the offer big enough to entice Natacha to take the cash.

programme.title: How to Clean Up for Cash
programme.desc: S1 E4Josie Gibson, Dan Hatfield and Jacqueline McLeod help Tim, who wants to sell items his girlfriend Sally has spent a lifetime collecting. programme.title: Barry Humphries: The Last Laugh
programme.desc: A profile of the comedy writer and performer, taking an upbeat and honest look back at the life and work of the trailblazer behind Dame Edna Everage and Sir Les Patterson. programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — EdinburghJames and his companion Tom Kitchin head to Edinburgh, but first they take a detour to a whisky distillery in Pitlochry, where James knocks up whisky chicken with wild mushroom and mustard sauce. Once they reach the capital, Tom shares his knowledge of the local fish, James gets fitted for a kilt and learns the history of the iconic garment, and the pair enjoy a bite to eat at Tom's Michelin-starred restaurant.

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry and Toby Stephens. After being betrayed during an operation in North Korea, agent James Bond is held prisoner by a ruthless military leader. A trade-off secures Bond's freedom, but his "00" agent status is withdrawn when he is suspected of leaking secret information. Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

As a result, one room is now full of old stock and new dad Dan wants it gone to create a bedroom for their daughter. Tensions run high when all is revealed - is the offer big enough to entice Natacha to take the cash.

programme.title: Barry Humphries: The Last Laugh
programme.desc: A profile of the comedy writer and performer, taking an upbeat and honest look back at the life and work of the trailblazer behind Dame Edna Everage and Sir Les Patterson. programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry and Toby Stephens. After being betrayed during an operation in North Korea, agent James Bond is held prisoner by a ruthless military leader. A trade-off secures Bond's freedom, but his "00" agent status is withdrawn when he is suspected of leaking secret information. Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

programme.desc: The season begins, and a new king reigns. But on the brutal icy roads of the legendary Rallye Monte-Carlo, legends and rivals are closing in. WRC More than Machine Season 2 is here!

programme.title: Episode 2: Now or Never - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: It's Now or Never! Rally Sweden’s icy roads and Safari Rally Kenya’s wild terrain push drivers to their limits. Rivals clash, teams strategise, and every second counts. Episode 2 now streaming!

programme.desc: With sights set on 2025, the M-Sport team tests their potential drivers for the upcoming season, determined to find their next leading contender. programme.desc: With everything on the line, bold risks and fearless moves will give you the crown. The moment where legends are forged and history is made. Don’t miss the epic conclusion of More Than Machine S2!

programme.desc: E1During WWII, the French Resistance seeks aid from SOE. Led by Vera Atkins, Odette Sansom and Noor Inayat Khan fight the Nazis, risking it all for victory.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Hawker Hurricane was the first RAF aircraft to fly over 300mph. Over half of every enemy aeroplane destroyed in the Battle of Britain was by a Hurricane, not a Spitfire.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II. Regarded as one of the most important aircraft of the Cold War. It was a major part of the United States Air Force, Navy and Marine Corps, and was also used by many other countries.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E1Nazi Germany boasted that its locomotives were faster and more innovative. This programme examines that claim by looking at these ‘flying trains’.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E9Learn about life on a Tudor ship from objects found on the Mary Rose, while on HMS Victory discover the battle-winning tactics of Admiral Nelson.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E10In 1939, the German raider Atlantis was equipped with fake funnels and her sailors dressed as women pushing prams to fool Allied merchant ships. We also look at how merchant ships were painted with bizarre shapes to fool U-boats.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E3In 1914, Russian designer Nikolay Lebedenko decided to engineer a solution to the problem of trench warfare with an armoured vehicle with huge wheels that could move over any terrain.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E4Discover the true story of a German Luftwaffe pilot in World War II who risked his own life to save the crew of an American B-17 bomber.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E3In 2008, nearly 850 people are killed in the Russo-Georgian War. How did it erupt and what is the current relationship between the two nations?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E4Soviet troops withdraw from Afghanistan in 1989 after fighting a force funded by the US. Should the US be blamed for the rise of Islamic terrorism.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3Often called 'the forgotten bomber', the mighty North American twin delivered the first blow in the fight back against Japan, in one of the most daring and audacious raids of all time.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4Cruelly called 'the packing case the B17 came in,' the Liberator more than proved its worth over Europe and the Pacific, patterning the B17 to deliver a blow to the axis powers in WWII however it wasn't simply a bomb delivery system.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E1Two iconic machines of World War II - the Spitfire symbolised British hope and resistance, while the Tiger tank embodied German power.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E5A Greenpeace ship is bombed in 1985, killing Fernando Pereira. The French authorities deny responsibility and questions over nuclear restrictions arise again.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The definitive combat helicopter saw first blood in South East Asia and has been transport, gunship, smoke ship, command centre, MediVac and dozens of other roles. We hear and see it's hair raising missions and watch it earn its fame.

programme.desc: E3Icons of the Royal Navy in different eras, the Belfast and the Harrier have earned their place in history for different reasons.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
